chose: Draw the card picture in a Convex Node action with Satori and @resvg/resvg-js, both listed as node.externalPackages
over: a hand-built SVG string rasterised in the default runtime, or a third-party screenshot service
because: Satori lays out text and flexbox from the same card facts, resvg is already the website's build-time PNG renderer, and the native binary must be installed by Convex rather than bundled

chose: Read RoundHog's woff2 from the installed @posthog/brand package at runtime and decode it in memory with wawoff2
over: committing RoundHog or a converted TTF to the repository, or drawing with a different open font
because: RoundHog is under the PolyForm Strict licence, which forbids distributing it or derivative works, and Silthus/kudos is public; Satori reads TTF, OTF and WOFF but not woff2

chose: Key each stored card picture by a SHA-256 of the drawing version and the card facts, without the as-of day
over: redrawing on every share, or keying by person
because: an unchanged card is never drawn again, a changed fact gets a new unguessable URL so Slack's kept unfolds stay as posted, and the day lives in the context line rather than the picture
